root_cause: The govuk-frontend Tabs component's handleKeyDown method incorrectly handles ArrowUp and ArrowDown keys for horizontal tabs, causing tab switching on vertical arrow keys. Per ARIA APG, horizontal tabs should only respond to ArrowLeft/ArrowRight for tab navigation; ArrowUp/ArrowDown should move focus into the tab panel.
repair_strategy: Modify the Tabs component's keydown handler to ignore ArrowUp and ArrowDown keys, allowing only ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (and Home/End) for horizontal tab navigation. This aligns with WCAG 2.1.1 and ARIA APG keyboard interface guidance.

edits.before:
handleKeyDown(event) {
      const tabs = Array.from(this.$tabs)
      const currentIndex = tabs.findIndex(tab => tab === document.activeElement)
      if (currentIndex === -1) return

      let newIndex
      switch (event.key) {
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          newIndex = currentIndex - 1
          break
        case 'ArrowRight':
          newIndex = currentIndex + 1
          break
        case 'ArrowUp':
        case 'ArrowDown':
          newIndex = currentIndex + (event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1)
          break
        case 'Home':
          newIndex = 0
          break
        case 'End':
          newIndex = tabs.length - 1
          break
        default:
          return
      }

      event.preventDefault()
      if (newIndex >= 0 && newIndex < tabs.length) {
        this.showTab(tabs[newIndex])
      }
    }

expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing ArrowDown or ArrowUp on a tab will no longer switch tabs; focus remains on the current tab and its panel stays visible. Users can navigate into the tab panel content with vertical arrows, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: If the component supports vertical tabs via aria-orientation, this change may break vertical tab navigation. However, the current implementation appears to assume horizontal tabs only.
Existing tests for vertical tab behavior (if any) may fail.
verification_requirements: Run the provided journey: seek to Past day tab, press ArrowDown, verify Past day tab remains selected (aria-selected=true) and #past-day panel visible.
Verify ArrowLeft/ArrowRight still move between tabs correctly.
Test with screen reader to ensure focus moves into panel on ArrowDown.
